name: VEEPON VeeX Pod System Kit 1000mAh 40W
description:
VEEPON VeeX Pod System Kit

VEEPON VeeX Pod Kit INTRODUCTION

VEEPON VeeX Pod System Kit features a built-in 1000mAh battery and an adjustable maximum power of 40W, delivering the smoothest vaping experience from RDL to MTL. The rectangular design consists of the cartridge and battery. The cartridge uses a state-of-the-art multi-layer leak-proof design and is compatible with the 510 interface drip tip. The firing button and adjustment buttons are located on opposite sides of the device, while the front features an LED screen displaying device information. The most unique feature of the VEEPON ​​VeeX is its compatibility with multiple coils, allowing you to experience both RDL and MTL vaping modes. The VEEPON ​​VeeX Pod System Kit is a reliable choice.

Features

• Dimensions: 103.8*28*18mm

• 1000mAh Rechargeable Battery

• Up to 40W Adjustable Output

• Advanced Mesh Coil Technology

• Multi-Layer Leak-Resistant Pod Design

• Adjustable Airflow Control

• Auto-Draw / Button Activation

• Compatible with VEEPON VeeX Pod Cartridges

• Compatible with Standard 510 Drip Tips

• 0.49-inch LED Display

• Compatible with 0.4ohm(26-40W) / 0.6ohm(20-28W) / 0.8ohm(14-20W) / 1.0ohm(12-18W) / 1.2ohm(10-15W) Coil
